name: ke.fhir.patient-summary
title: Kenya Patient Summary Implementation Guide
description:
This Implementation Guide defines the structure, constraints, and terminologies for a Kenya Patient Summary (KPS) based on HL7 FHIR R4. It enables secure, portable, and standardized summaries of essential patient health information across Kenya's digital health ecosystem, aligned with the Digital Health Act 2023 and the International Patient Summary (IPS) standard.
 (built Sun, Aug 16, 2026 12:29+0000+00:00)
